title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Plugin parameters. The settings-manager group (settingsManagerGroup) is REQUIRED — until it is set, the plugin runs in read-only mode (writes are denied). This protects fresh installs from settings tampering.

settingsManagerGroup.title: Plugin settings manager group (required)
settingsManagerGroup.description: Name of a YouTrack group whose members can access the «Plugin settings» widget. While empty, all plugin mutations are denied (deny-by-default). Set only by a project administrator via Project Settings → Apps. CANNOT be set from inside the plugin — this removes the chicken-and-egg vulnerability of initial setup.

enableDebugLog.title: Verbose logging (diagnostics only)
enableDebugLog.description: Enables verbose backend logs in the YouTrack server log. Do not enable in production — logs may contain diagnostic dumps of internal data structures. Use only when investigating incidents.
